description: This file defines the 'MenuItem' entity class within the OrangeHRM system, including attributes such as id, title, parent item, level, order, status, associated screen, and additional parameters. It uses Doctrine ORM for mapping to a database table 'ohrm_menu_item'.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Represents a menu item entity with properties like id, title, parent item, level, order, status, associated screen, and additional parameters, mapped to the database.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the menu item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the menu item.

methods.name: getMenuTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the menu item.

methods.name: setMenuTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the menu item.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent menu item, if any.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the hierarchy level of the menu item.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the hierarchy level of the menu item.

methods.name: getOrderHint
methods.description: Returns the order hint for display.

methods.name: setOrderHint
methods.description: Sets the order hint for display.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the menu item is active or not.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the active/inactive status of the menu item.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the Screen entity associated with this menu item.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Associates a Screen entity with this menu item.

methods.name: getAdditionalParams
methods.description: Returns additional parameters stored as a JSON array.

methods.name: setAdditionalParams
methods.description: Sets additional parameters for the menu item.
